title: Verify public Student World bridge propagation and live routes
mission: From a network-capable verifier, independently fetch the published Student World -> Jose canary and both live Jose destinations, record concrete HTTP/browser evidence, and close only the public-propagation residual. Do not mutate candidate or promotion authority.
definition_of_done: Public canary returns a successful document response and its served content matches the expected candidate identity.
Embedded Student World public URL loads successfully from the canary context or equivalent browser evidence is recorded.
Jose Study and Jose Algebra destinations both resolve/load successfully.
Exact response/browser evidence and observation time are persisted.
No Current, Catalog, Human Accepted or Served pointer is changed.
